description: Estimate public USD starting costs. Inspection: sampleChecks; prep: units; standalone pick-pack: orders. Storage: cubicMeters and either storageDays or months (30 days each), plus alreadyStoredDays when the batch is not new. The same batch gets 90 free days, not a new grace period. Yanwen parcel rates include standard pick-pack: do not add the standalone fee. Sourcing is quote-only. This does not quote, bill, purchase or ship.

alreadyStoredDays.description: Days already elapsed since actual receipt of this same batch. Defaults to zero for a new batch.

cubicMeters.description: Estimated stored volume in CBM, up to three decimal places; not a warehouse measurement.

months.description: Total planned duration in 30-day periods. Do not also provide storageDays.

service.description: Choose sourcing, inspection, prep, storage or fulfillment.

storageDays.description: Planned additional storage days. Prefer days for precise free-period estimates.
